jobs_results.title: Senior Associate, HRBP Operations (Contract Role)
jobs_results.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Role Summary

We are looking for an organised, proactive and detail-oriented HR professional to support the HRBP team across people initiatives, employee engagement, data and reporting, communications and day-to-day operations. The role will work closely with HRBPs and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution of people initiatives and enable a smooth employee experience.

Roles & Responsibilities



HRBP Enablement: Provide day-to-day operational support to HRBPs, including scheduling, follow-ups, trackers and coordination across ongoing people initiatives.People Initiatives & Engagement: Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, All Hands, town halls and other HR events, owning the end-to-end coordination and logistics.Communication & Presentation Support: Create and support HR communications, leadership decks, All Hands presentations and other employee-facing collaterals.Data & Reporting: Maintain HR dashboards and trackers, support basic data analysis and prepare People & Culture reports and insights for leadership reviews.Cross-functional & Vendor Coordination: Work with Finance, CREWs, Payroll, Benefits and other stakeholders on HR-related requirements, including procurement, invoices, vendor payments and employee milestone requirements.Process Improvement: Support the HRBP team in streamlining recurring processes, improving trackers and ways of working, and driving operational efficiency.End-to-end Ownership: Take ownership of assigned HR initiatives from planning through execution and closure, ensuring timely follow-ups and stakeholder alignment.


Mandatory Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in any discipline.1–3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Coordination, People Operations or a similar role.Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets, including trackers, dashboards and basic data analysis.Good presentation and visual communication skills; proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides. Basic Canva/design skills would be an advantage.Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines.Proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.Strong ownership and ability to independently drive tasks to closure.


Note: This is a Contract Role 

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a driven and knowledgeable Individual  to lead Payment Gateway (PG) business growth across strategic high potential locations. The ideal candidate will have a strong grasp of the payments ecosystem, hands-on experience working with banks and financial institutions, and the ability to build and leverage government relationships to drive adoption and revenue. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Payment Gateway Sales & Business Development 

•  Own end-to-end sales of PG solutions to merchants, enterprises, and institutions in the assigned strategic location 

•  Identify, prospect, and close high-value merchants across sectors such as retail, education, healthcare, and government 

•  Drive acquisition of new accounts while growing revenue from existing merchant partnerships 

•  Pitch and position PG products including payment links, UPI, cards, EMI, and BNPL solutions based on merchant needs 

 Bank & Financial Institution Management   

•  Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and cooperative banks, NBFCs, and nodal banking partners 

•  Lead commercial negotiations including MDR, settlement cycles, credit limits, and partnership terms 

•  Coordinate with bank partners for faster onboarding, issue resolution, and co-selling opportunities 

•  Stay updated on RBI guidelines, banking circulars, and compliance requirements affecting PG operations 

 Government & Institutional Relationships 

•  Develop and manage relationships with state and local government bodies, PSUs, and municipalities for PG adoption in public services 

•  Identify and pursue opportunities in government collections — utility payments, tax portals, welfare disbursements, and e-governance projects 

•  Represent the company in government tenders, RFPs, and empanelment processes 

•  Liaise with government officials and decision-makers to position the company as a preferred payments partner 

  Commercial Negotiation & Deal Structuring 

•  Lead pricing discussions and commercial structuring for large and strategic deals 

•  Collaborate with internal product, risk, and finance teams to create customized proposals 

•  Ensure deal profitability while maintaining competitive positioning in the market 

 Market Intelligence & Reporting 

•  Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and emerging merchant needs across assigned strategic locations 

•  Provide regular pipeline reports, forecasts, and market insights to regional leadership 

•  Represent ground-level feedback to product teams for localization and feature improvements 

 What We're Looking For Must-

 Have Skills & Experience 

•  4–8 years of experience in Payment Gateway, Fintech, or Banking sales 

•  Deep understanding of PG infrastructure — acquiring banks, payment networks, settlement flows, risk & compliance 

•  Proven track record of commercial negotiation with banks or financial institutions 

•  Experience managing or engaging with government bodies or PSUs for payments/fintech solutions 

•  Strong hunter mentality with a consultative sales approach 

•  Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder influence skills 

 Good to Have 

•  Prior experience working in or extensively covering the assigned strategic location 

•  Existing network of merchants, bank officials, or government contacts in Chandigarh, Lucknow, Chennai, Hyderabad, or Kolkata 

•  Familiarity with RBI payment regulations, PCI-DSS, and digital payment policies 

•  Understanding of GST, e-invoicing, or government payment use cases 



 Location -  Chennai

jobs_results.title: Associate Manager, Key Accounts Management
jobs_results.description:
Company Overview
Razorpay is a leading full-stack financial solutions company, empowering businesses across India to manage their finances with ease and efficiency. We provide a comprehensive suite of products, including payment gateways, banking solutions, and lending services, enabling businesses to accept, process, and disburse payments seamlessly. Operating at the forefront of the digital payments revolution, Razorpay serves a vast and diverse ecosystem of merchants, from burgeoning startups to established enterprises, driving innovation and simplifying complex financial operations.


Role Overview
As an Associate Manager, Startup Accounts, you will be at the forefront of Razorpay's engagement with India's most innovative and high-growth startups. This role involves strategically managing a portfolio of key startup clients, fostering deep relationships with founders and CXOs, and driving significant revenue growth. You will act as a trusted advisor, understanding their unique business challenges and positioning Razorpay's comprehensive financial solutions to accelerate their success.


Your day-to-day will involve strategic account planning, consultative sales, cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering teams, and ensuring an unparalleled client experience. This position is critical in nurturing the next generation of industry leaders and expanding Razorpay's footprint within the dynamic startup ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute strategic account plans for a portfolio of high-potential startup clients to maximize product adoption, revenue growth, and long-term partnership value.Cultivate and strengthen deep, lasting relationships with key decision-makers, including founders and C-level executives, within assigned startup accounts, serving as their primary strategic point of contact.Identify and proactively pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts by conducting thorough needs assessments and strategically positioning Razorpay's diverse suite of financial products.Collaborate seamlessly with internal product, engineering, and support teams to ensure successful client onboarding, efficient issue resolution, and the effective adoption of new features.Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and client performance data to provide actionable insights and inform strategic business decisions for both clients and Razorpay.Lead negotiations for complex commercial agreements and renewals, ensuring mutually beneficial terms that drive sustained client satisfaction and revenue targets.Represent Razorpay at prominent industry events, conferences, and startup ecosystem gatherings to enhance brand visibility and generate qualified leads.
Required Skillset
Demonstrated expertise in Key Account Management and B2B Sales, with a proven track record of managing and growing strategic client relationships, particularly within the startup ecosystem.Strong consultative sales capabilities, adept at understanding intricate business challenges and crafting tailored financial solutions that deliver tangible value.Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, enabling effective engagement with C-level executives, founders, and diverse stakeholders.Proven strategic thinking and analytical abilities to identify growth opportunities, anticipate client needs, and navigate complex market dynamics.High degree of proactivity, self-motivation, and resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment with ambitious growth objectives.A solid understanding of the fintech landscape, digital payments, SaaS business models, or the broader startup ecosystem is highly desirable.Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA from a premier institution is a significant advantage.Ability to work effectively in an on-site, collaborative team environment based in Bangalore, fostering strong internal and external relationships.

Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.


But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here.


People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.


About Razorpay
Razorpay is a leading full-stack financial services organization building a new-age digital banking hub (Neobank) for businesses. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar, Razorpay processes multi-billion-dollar payment volumes annually across India and international markets, touching over 200 million end-customers through industry leaders such as Airtel, Goibibo, Yatra, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato, and Cred.


The company has raised over $700 million in funding from marquee investors including GIC, Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, and Matrix Partners. Razorpay's suite of digital offerings spans Payment Gateway, RazorpayX (Business Banking), Razorpay Capital (MSME Lending), Payment Links, Payment Pages, Subscriptions, Smart Collect, Route, Payroll, and Razorpay POS.


About Razorpay POS Razorpay POS is Razorpay’s comprehensive suite of point-of-sale payment solutions, enabling businesses to accept seamless payments across all customer touchpoints—over the counter, on delivery, or via kiosks and vending machines. Powering over 600,000+ touchpoints across India & the UAE, Razorpay POS (formerly Ezetap, acquired in August 2022) delivers high transaction success rates, real-time transaction analytics via the merchant portal, and flexible in-store EMI options for consumers.


Role Overview
We are looking for an energetic Banking Solutions Consultant (Manager - Banking Solutions) with domain expertise in digital payments, bank gateway integrations, merchant acquiring, and pre-sales technical consulting.
In this role, you will act as a solution evangelist—stitching together Razorpay’s product capabilities to solve stated and unstated business requirements for banks, alliance partners, and enterprise merchants. You will combine deep technical understanding with product and program management to lead solution discovery, design custom payment architectures, and drive integrations to deployment.


Key Responsibilities
Pre-Sales Consulting & Solution Discovery



Present and demonstrate Razorpay’s unique value proposition during executive presentations and discovery sessions with prospective and existing bank partners and enterprise merchants.
Map Razorpay’s product suite (Payment Gateway, POS, RazorpayX, Capital) and roadmap against customer requirements to design end-to-end payment architectures.
Prepare functional scope documents (FSD), product requirement documents (PRD), and technical scope of work specifications for merchant acquiring solutions.

Partner & Bank Co-Creation

Partner with banks, card networks, and processors to co-create next-generation payment and banking solutions that address evolving merchant needs.
Serve as the strategic bridge between Razorpay and external banking product and sales teams to drive ecosystem alignment.

Platform & Program Delivery

Manage and deliver merchant acquiring payment platforms across delivery channels including payment gateways, transaction processing, settlements, and dispute management.
Collaborate internally with Razorpay's business, product, engineering, and customer success teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Facilitate support during UAT, certification testing, SDLC tracking, and platform troubleshooting across both issuing and acquiring frameworks.

Relationship & Stakeholder Management

Maintain proactive communication with bank leadership regarding product delivery roadmaps, platform upgrades, and feature rollouts.
Drive conversations across cross-functional groups, resolve alignment conflicts, and maintain momentum across long-term project lifecycles.

Experience
Qualifications & Skills

Minimum 5+ years of experience in pre-sales, technical consulting, product management, or platform delivery within digital payments, merchant acquiring, IT, or a leading financial institution.
Prior experience at a fintech company with exposure to banks, or within a bank's product/payments team, is strongly preferred.

Education

MBA graduate with a solid background in software technology and architecture.

Domain & Technical Knowledge

In-depth understanding of payment products, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, transaction processing, card networks, settlement mechanics, and dispute workflows.
Hands-on familiarity with end-to-end (ETED) transaction flows, SDLC processes, and system troubleshooting.
Expertise in issuing and acquiring solutions offered to business partners.
Exposure to payment network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, Rupay) and security certifications is a strong plus.

Core Competencies

Solution Evangelism: Ability to synthesize complex technical features into intuitive business solutions.
Documentation & Presentation: Exceptional documentation skills (PRDs, FSDs) and executive presentation capabilities.
Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to manage and influence internal product teams, external bank executives, and merchant partners.
Communication & Drive: Outstanding written and verbal communication, high energy, adaptability, and conflict resolution capabilities across distributed teams

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Analyst to join the KAM Operations (Ops) team within Razorpay Engage's Loyalty business. This role sits at the center of our client and merchant operations, working closely with Account Managers, Partnerships, Finance, and Client Support to ensure every operational workflow runs accurately and on time.

Offer & Reward Uploads – Manage end-to-end upload of offers, gift cards, and rewards for internal and client requests.
Invoicing Requests – Own the invoicing lifecycle from Proforma Invoice request through to final Tax Invoice and payment tracking.
Reporting incl. Ad Hoc Reports – Support report setup at program launch and fulfil ad hoc client reporting requests.

jobs_results.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here.

People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

jobs_results.description:
GRC engineer is a combination of two prime areas. One is regulatory and compliance depth frameworks, control design and testing, audit judgement, deviations, the Indian financial-sector stack. The other is AI-native practice assessing AI and LLM systems for compliance risk, evaluating AI tools and vendors before they are onboarded, using AI for the mechanical half of the work with validation as a reflex, and directing AI tooling to build the monitoring and evidence automation the function needs.


Razorpay operates under one of the densest regulatory stacks in Indian technology the DPDP Act 2023, RBI Payment Aggregator and Payment Gateway directions, the PPI Master Directions, RBI Digital Payment Security Controls and Cyber Security Framework expectations, PCI DSS v4.X, ISO 27001 and 27701, and SOC 2 simultaneously, not sequentially. Doing this by hand does not scale to our velocity. AI handles the highvolume, repetitive work: evidence collection and summarisation, control crosswalking, drafting test procedures, parsing audit logs, first-pass alert triage, questionnaire response.


It is treated like a fast junior analyst whose output is always reviewed.


Key Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end control lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, evidence, and audit readiness


Drive risk assessments, audit findings (deviations), and remediation closure with clear ownershipReview cloud security (AWS/GCP), IAM, application security, and data protection controls in production systemsEvaluate and govern AI/LLM systems, tools, and vendors for data security, privacy, and compliance risksBuild automation-first GRC systems: continuous monitoring, evidence pipelines, and control validation frameworksSupport and lead regulatory audits (RBI, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) with production-backed evidencePartner with engineering to embed controls into architecture and SDLC (policy-as-code mindset)Own third-party/vendor risk assessments with a strong technical lens What Were Looking For - 4+ years of experience in GRC, IT audit, security, or compliance engineeringStrong hands-on expertise in security and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ITGC, DPDP)Solid understanding of cloud security, IAM, secure SDLC, and data protection controlsProven experience in risk management, audit handling, and control testingExposure to AI/LLM risk, data governance, and vendor security assessmentsAbility to translate deep technical findings into business risk and actionable insights Preferred - Experience in fintech or regulated environments (RBI, payments, banking)Hands-on with GRC tools (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe) or compliance automation systemsFamiliarity with automation, scripting, APIs, or policy-as-code approachesExperience building monitoring, evidence collection, or compliance pipelines Why This Role - Work on AI + Compliance + Engineering convergenceBuild scalable, automation-first GRC systems instead of manual audit workflowsHigh ownership role influencing security posture and regulatory strategyOpportunity to set the technical bar for GRC engineering .
